description: This file contains type definitions, functions for migrating settings, applying overrides, and merging string arrays related to Tlon monitor settings in a software project.

methods.name: buildTlonSettingsMigrations
methods.description: Generates migration objects for various Tlon account settings based on current account data and settings store.

methods.name: shouldMigrateTlonSetting
methods.description: Determines if a Tlon setting should be migrated based on the presence of file and settings values.

methods.name: applyTlonSettingsOverrides
methods.description: Applies overrides to the current settings based on account data, with optional logging.

methods.name: mergeUniqueStrings
methods.description: Merges two string arrays, ensuring uniqueness.
